answer: Think of Interchain message-passport with sequence numbers as a toll booth: sequence numbers no relayer can forge, so the kernel of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Honest agents barely notice the check, because sequence numbers no relayer can forge is something they already have; the sable falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The whisper is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
